modelCaveat: This is the maximum permitted settlement zoning envelope, not an architectural design or a verified finished facade. Contours follow the actual settlement diagram rather than stretching a superseded City model. The height-zone surfaces are independently extruded; coincident hidden surfaces remain. Cladding, railings, detailed balconies, structural openings and landscaping are not inferred. Building base is the median sampled Ontario DTM grade, not a legally calculated or approved established grade. Relative maximum heights are taken verbatim from the governing diagram. The July 10, 2025 order labels the 33-storey height 105.7 m; a later City surrounding-development report lists 107.7 m. This model uses the governing order and preserves that discrepancy explicitly. The order permits rooftop appurtenances up to 7.5 m above the height limit, but no footprint is delineated, so they are omitted. A maximum projection permission does not establish a constructed rooftop form. The existing 28-storey apartment 92-2023 is retained. The settlement replaces the obsolete 38-storey source geometry. The podium courtyard curve is sampled from the zoning diagram; it is a simplified maximum buildable perimeter.
